title: BEST BEDROCK BONEMEAL FARM 1.21 Minecraft Tutorial! - MCPE/Xbox/PS4/Nintendo Switch/Windows 10/PC

In this video, I will show you how to build the next generation of bonemeal farming based on kelp farming faster than before using a new core setup. This makes it as fast as the first version of a hyper-light kelp-based farm, which was extremely fast, making one stack in a few seconds in Minecraft!

If you enjoy this channel will focus on high-performance and simple farms that are beyond levels of bedrock so be sure to turn on the notification to be notified!
